title: Leaves and generations
intro: Diomedes finishes his warning. Glaucus answers with the leaf simile, then begins Bellerophon's story.

notes.text: θύσθλα, Bacchic wands / ritual branches; χαμαί, to the ground; καταχέω epic 3pl aor, poured / dropped.
θείνω, strike: pres pass ptc nom fem pl; βουπλήξ, ox-goad: dat sg.
φοβέω aor pass ptc, terrified / put to flight; δύω mixed 3sg aor mid, “plunged beneath the sea.”
ὑποδέχομαι, receive / shelter: 3sg aor mid; κόλπος, bosom / lap: dat sg.
δείδω perf ptc acc sg, afraid; τρόμος, trembling; ὁμοκλή, threatening shout: dat sg of cause.
ὀδύσσομαι, be angry with: 3pl aor mid + dat τῷ, Lycurgus; not ὀδύρομαι, lament.
“Living at ease”; ῥεῖα adv., easily; ζώω pres ptc. Divine ease contrasts with mortal troubles.
τίθημι aor, made blind; ἀπεχθάνομαι, become hated: 3sg 2aor mid + dat gods.
μάκαρ, blessed: dat pl; ἐθέλω 1sg pres opt + ἄν, “I would not wish to fight.”
ἄρουρα, cultivated land; καρπός, produce; ἔδω, eat: 3pl pres. Eating grain marks mortality.
ἆσσον, nearer; εἶμι 2sg imperative, come; θᾶσσον, sooner / more quickly. Rhyming comparatives sharpen the threat.
πεῖραρ, limit / bond: acc pl πείρατα; ἱκνέομαι 2sg aor mid subj. “Reach destruction's bounds / bonds”; image disputed, Murray renders “toils.”
γενεή, lineage / generation; ἐρεείνω, inquire about: 2sg pres.
“Just as … so”; correlated feminine adjectives with γενεή. Mortal generations resemble successive leaves.
χαμάδις, to the ground; ὕλη, woodland / forest, subject of φύει.
τηλεθάω, flourish: epic expanded pres ptc nom fem sg; φύω transitive here, “puts forth [new leaves].”
ἔαρ, spring: gen sg; ὥρη, season; ἐπιγίγνομαι, come on / arrive.
φύω intransitive, grows / arises; ἀπολήγω, cease / die out. The one generation … the other.
δάω, learn: epic 2aor pass inf; οἶδα 2sg perf subj with present sense, “so that you may know.”
οἶδα, know: 3pl perf indicative with present sense; compare Attic ἴσασι.
μυχός, innermost part: dat sg; ἱππόβοτος, horse-pasturing: gen sg. Argos here the wider region, not necessarily the city.
ἔσκε, iterative past of εἰμί; κέρδιστος, craftiest / most cunning, from κέρδος, gain.
τίκτω, beget: unaugmented 3sg 2aor mid, then 3sg impf act. Sisyphus → Glaucus → Bellerophon.
ἠνορέη, manliness / manly strength; ἐρατεινός, lovely / desirable: acc fem sg.
ὀπάζω, grant: 3pl aor; μήδομαι, devise: unaugmented 3sg aor mid, κακά its object.
ἐλαύνω, drive out: 3sg aor, epic -σσ-; δῆμος, land / community; Ἀργείων follows next page.
φέρτερος, stronger / more powerful; ἦεν = ἦν. Proetus has superior political power.
